output.recommendation: A domain-level policy recommendation would be for network operators and emergency services to establish a formal notification channel. This should include requiring network operators to notify emergency dispatch centers within 30 minutes of detecting any outage affecting emergency call delivery, mirroring the requirement in [G1], US-47CFR-PART4 § 4.9(h)(4). Additionally, it would be beneficial for emergency services to have a direct query mechanism into the network status, as suggested by [G2], EU-EECC-2018 Article 108.
output.rationale: This recommendation ensures that when AI-driven faults degrade emergency-call delivery, the operator with knowledge of the cause can promptly notify emergency dispatch centers. It also allows for a direct query into network status by emergency services, thereby reducing time-to-awareness and improving overall service reliability.
